entries.name: MultipeerConnectivity
entries.note: Nearby sharing finds peers with a UDP beacon and sends files and bytes over TCP after an explicit accept. Apps get no sessions, invitations or messages, and the SDK row records that nothing is encrypted in transit.
entries.ready_note: Nearby sharing (UDP beacon discovery, TCP transfer after accept) in net::share, tested. App sessions and invitations are not covered.

entries.name: NetFS
entries.note: The kernel mount helpers mount.cifs and mount.nfs from the cifs-utils and nfs-utils packages mount network shares. Apps get no mount API and the desktop has no connect-to-server flow, so the row stays partial.
entries.ready_note: The cifs-utils package provides mount.cifs and the kernel mount helpers mount network shares on the installed system.

entries.ready_note: Session publish and command routing to the owner, hardware media keys to the owner, and lock card feedback and rating (service and SDK models), covered by unit tests. Drawing the lock card controls and the Control Center wiring are not part of this check.

entries.name: OSAKit
entries.note: Scripting runs through the JSON-RPC control socket that apps expose. Gap: there is no embeddable script editor component and no OSA language runtime.
entries.ready_note: Scripting runs through the JSON-RPC control socket (bifrost-app control), tested. An embeddable script editor and an OSA language runtime are not covered.

entries.name: OSAnalytics
entries.note: Crash reports are listed and sent only when the user shares them; the report bundle is built and parsed in shell::diag and tested in that file. Gap: no app-facing analytics event API and no aggregated usage counters.
entries.ready_note: Crash report bundles are built and parsed in shell::diag, tested. Reference analytics upload is not covered.

entries.name: OSLog
entries.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/log.rs (re-exports springboard/core/src/log.rs); bifrost-log CLI (springboard/sdk/src/bin/bifrost-log.rs); Console app (springboard/apps/console-desktop)
entries.note: The read side (LogStore entries and the bifrost-log show command) and the write side (Logger levels, subsystem registry, per-subsystem private and level config) are built, with journald as the store. Entries, activities, signposts, boundaries, enumerator and position tokens, and format payloads are not built.
entries.ready_note: Logging is built: springboard/core/src/log.rs (LogStore read side, Logger write side, subsystem registry) behind bifrost_app::log, the bifrost-log CLI and the Console app. Journald is the store.

entries.name: OpenAL
entries.note: The audio service plays and captures PCM streams. Gap: there is no positional 3D source API like the one OpenAL offers.

entries.name: OpenCL
entries.note: Mesa is the Arch OpenCL provider path if its build enables the rusticl driver, which is not verified on Midget. Apps get no compute SDK, so this is partial at the system layer only.

entries.name: OpenDirectory
entries.note: from SDK matrix open-directory.json

entries.name: OpenGL
entries.note: Mesa supplies the OpenGL and EGL drivers on the Arch runtime. Apps get no GL SDK surface, and the desktop draws through the GPU crate.

entries.name: MCCFoundation
entries.note: Foundation of the reference vendor's iCloud managed-configuration kit (bundle com.apple.icloudmcckit.mccfoundation). It serves that account service, which BifrOSt does not mirror.

entries.name: MCCKitCategorization_macOS
entries.note: Category model assets for the reference vendor's iCloud managed-configuration kit. The models serve that account service, which BifrOSt does not mirror.

entries.name: MDMClientLibrary
entries.note: Client for the reference vendor's mobile device management protocol (bundle com.apple.devicemanagementclient). It talks to the vendor's enterprise servers, which BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: MDSChannel
entries.note: Only the bundle identifier (com.apple.MDSChannel) was readable from the reference image. Its job is not determined, so it stays os.

entries.name: MFAAuthentication
entries.note: Two-factor sign-in for the reference vendor's account, served by its network XPC service (MFAANetwork). BifrOSt Cloud runs its own sign-in, so the vendor's flow has no counterpart.

entries.name: MFiAuthentication
entries.note: Authentication for the reference vendor's certified accessory chips (its accessory certification program). BifrOSt has no such program, and the component has no meaning on PC hardware.

entries.name: MIL
entries.note: Model intermediate language used by the reference on-device ML compiler. BifrOSt has no model compiler or model format, so the row does not apply.

entries.name: MLAssetIO
entries.note: Loads model assets for the reference's on-device machine learning. BifrOSt has no on-device model runtime, so this has no counterpart yet and stays os.

entries.name: MLCompilerRuntime
entries.note: Runtime for the reference on-device model compiler. BifrOSt has no model compiler stack, and the reference format it compiles is Apple-only.

entries.name: MLCompilerServices
entries.note: XPC compile service for the reference on-device model compiler (MLCompilerOSXPC). BifrOSt has no model compiler stack, so the row does not apply.

entries.name: MLIR_ML
entries.note: MLIR-based ML toolchain of the reference, with its model viewer tool. BifrOSt has no model compiler stack, so the row does not apply.

entries.name: MLModelAsset
entries.note: Model asset packaging for the reference on-device ML (com.apple.ggml.ModelAsset). It is an Apple model-pack format that BifrOSt does not use.

entries.name: MLModelCache
entries.note: Cache of prepared on-device models (bundle com.apple.mlpt.ODIE). BifrOSt has no model cache, so it stays os.

entries.name: MLModelSpecification
entries.note: Model file format specification of the reference on-device ML. BifrOSt has no model format, so the row does not apply.

entries.name: MLRuntime
entries.note: Inference runtime for the reference's on-device machine learning. BifrOSt runs no models on the device, so it stays os.

entries.name: MMCS
entries.note: Content transfer for the reference vendor's cloud sync (bundle com.apple.cloudkit.MMCS). It serves that vendor's cloud storage, which BifrOSt Cloud does not use this way.

entries.name: MMCSServices
entries.note: XPC services behind the reference vendor's cloud content transfer (com.apple.mmcsservices). BifrOSt has no vendor cloud sync, so it has no counterpart.

entries.name: MSGExternalSync
entries.note: Only the bundle identifier (com.apple.MSGExternalSync) was readable from the reference image. Its job is not determined, so it stays os.

entries.name: MSUDataAccessor
entries.note: The shell checks for and applies over-the-air OS updates from the update manifest. The reference's data accessor for software update catalogues is not mirrored, so apps get no update data API.
entries.ready_note: The shell checks for and applies OS updates (shell::ota, 25 tests). The reference catalogue accessor is not covered.

entries.name: MTInferenceToolLib
entries.note: Inference tooling library of the reference model toolchain, used by Apple's internal tools. It has no BifrOSt meaning.

entries.name: MTL3On4
entries.note: The GPU crate gives a Metal-shaped API over Vulkan to the window server and to SDK drawing. The reference's Metal 3 layer on its newer GPU driver is not mirrored, and apps get no GPU API.

entries.name: MTLCompiler
entries.note: Shaders are GLSL that build.rs compiles to SPIR-V at build time and embeds in the binary. The reference compiles shaders at run time in a compiler service, and BifrOSt has no run-time shader compiler or app shader API.
entries.ready_note: Shaders are GLSL compiled to SPIR-V at build time (bifrost-gpu shader, tested). Run-time compilation in a compiler service is not mirrored.

entries.name: MTLSimDriver
entries.note: Simulator driver for the reference vendor's developer simulator (XPC host MTLSimDriverHost). It has no meaning on a PC desktop.

entries.name: MTLSimImplementation
entries.note: Simulator implementation of the GPU API for the reference vendor's developer simulator. It has no meaning on a PC desktop.

entries.name: MXI
entries.note: Looked for the purpose in the reference index and the extracted tree: only the framework skeleton is listed, with no binary, headers or bundle resources, and no name points at a BifrOSt counterpart. Left as os until it can be read.

entries.name: MacMailSearchProcessing
entries.note: Mail search is limited to the open mailbox in mail-desktop/src/search.rs, and no message reaches the shell search index in springboard/src/shell/spotindex.rs. Build a message indexer in the Mail app that feeds the Search panel.

entries.name: MacSystemUI
entries.note: The menu bar, dock and control centre are drawn by the shell, so the system chrome exists. Not mirrored: a shared chrome library that other apps link, and extension points for third-party items.
entries.ready_note: The menu bar, dock and control centre are drawn by the shell (shell::desktop_bar, shell::desktop_dock, shell::control_center), tested. A shared chrome library for other apps is not covered.

entries.name: MachineSettings
entries.note: The Settings app with its pages and search is in the shell. Not covered: a framework that other apps use to add their own settings panes.
entries.ready_note: The Settings app with its pages and search (shell::settings, shell::settings_search), tested. A framework for apps to add panes is not covered.

entries.name: MacinTalk
entries.note: Text to speech runs through the speech service: apps speak an utterance with a voice and rate, and the say tool and the screen reader use the same engine, espeak-ng, which is now in packaging/arch/runtime-packages.txt. Gap: no word or sentence events, no pitch or volume, and the reference voice catalogue is not mirrored.
entries.ready_note: The speech stack is built: engine programs and voice parsing (springboard/core/src/speech_engine.rs), the speech service (springboard/src/shell/services/speech.rs), the SDK speech API (springboard/sdk/src/speech.rs) and the say tool (springboard/cmd/src/say.rs). espeak-ng is in runtime-packages.txt.

entries.name: MacinTalkCore
entries.note: The speech core (engine programs, voice and rate arguments, voice listing parser) is in springboard/core/src/speech_engine.rs and drives espeak-ng. Gap: the reference voice catalogue and its synthesis are not mirrored.
entries.ready_note: The speech stack is built: engine programs and voice parsing (springboard/core/src/speech_engine.rs), the speech service (springboard/src/shell/services/speech.rs), the SDK speech API (springboard/sdk/src/speech.rs) and the say tool (springboard/cmd/src/say.rs). espeak-ng is in runtime-packages.txt.

entries.name: MagnifierServices
entries.note: The shell magnifier zooms the screen from magnifier.rs. Not mirrored: the reference zoom service process and its app intents.
entries.ready_note: The shell magnifier zoom (shell::magnifier), tested. The reference zoom service process is not mirrored.

entries.name: MagnifierSupport
entries.note: The shell magnifier zooms the screen from magnifier.rs. Not mirrored: the reference support code for the zoom feature and its app intents.
entries.ready_note: The shell magnifier zoom (shell::magnifier), tested. The reference support code and app intents are not mirrored.

entries.name: Mail
entries.note: The Mail app has accounts, the window, IMAP and SMTP transport. Not mirrored: a shared mail framework that other apps link.
entries.ready_note: Mail window, IMAP and SMTP transport in mail-desktop, tested. A shared mail framework for other apps is not covered.

entries.name: MailCore
entries.note: Message headers, MIME parsing and draft rendering are in mail-desktop. Not covered: a shared mail model that other apps can open mailboxes through.
entries.ready_note: Message headers and MIME parsing in mail-desktop (message, mime), tested. A shared mail model for other apps is not covered.

entries.name: MailSearchSchemaManifest
entries.note: Mail messages are not registered with the shell search index in springboard/src/shell/spotindex.rs, so there is no searchable schema for them. Build the field schema for mail messages and send it to the shell index from the Mail app.

entries.name: MailService
entries.note: Account sync runs on worker threads in sync.rs while the window is open. Not mirrored: a background mail agent that keeps accounts synced while the app is closed.
entries.ready_note: Account sync runs on worker threads in the sync module while the window is open. A background agent that keeps accounts synced while closed is not built.

entries.name: MailSupport
entries.note: The Mail window state and preferences are in mail-desktop. Not covered: support services that other mail components call.
entries.ready_note: Mail window state and preferences (state, prefs), tested. Support services for other components are not covered.

entries.name: MailUI
entries.note: The Mail window's drawing and input are in mail-desktop. Not covered: a shared mail UI kit and the reference's mail web bundle.
entries.ready_note: Mail window drawing and input (draw, window), tested. A shared mail UI kit is not covered.

entries.name: MailWebProcessSupport
entries.note: HTML mail is cleaned of scripts and remote content in html.rs and rendered in-process. Not mirrored: the reference's separate web process for mail content.
entries.ready_note: HTML mail is cleaned of scripts and remote content in mail-desktop html, tested. The separate web process is not mirrored.

entries.name: MallocStackLogging
entries.note: valgrind traces heap allocations and leaks for debugging, which covers the purpose on Linux. It has no switch like the reference allocation logging, and apps get no in-process allocation log.
entries.ready_note: valgrind is installed from runtime-packages.txt and traces heap allocations and leaks, which is the job of allocation logging on Linux.

entries.name: ManagedAppsCore
entries.note: Policy engine for managed apps under enterprise device management. It applies rules pushed by a management server, and BifrOSt runs no enrolment or management server to receive them.

entries.name: ManagedAppsInterface
entries.note: Interface to the managed-apps policy engine of enterprise device management. BifrOSt has no management server, so there is no policy for it to apply.

entries.name: ManagedBackgroundAssets
entries.note: Background downloads for apps are in the SDK and the UI model. Not mirrored: the vendor's asset delivery service and its fetching from vendor servers.
entries.ready_note: Background downloads for apps are modelled in bifrost_ui::managed_download with unit tests, and the SDK exposes them through the background download module. The vendor asset servers are not part of this check.

entries.name: ManagedBackgroundAssetsHelper
entries.note: Background downloads for apps are in the SDK and the UI model. Not mirrored: the helper service process that runs the asset downloads for the reference system.

entries.name: ManagedBackgroundAssetsHelperFetching
entries.note: Background downloads for apps are in the SDK and the UI model. Not mirrored: the fetching service process of the reference helper.

entries.name: ManagedBackgroundAssetsRelay
entries.note: Background downloads for apps are in the SDK and the UI model. Not mirrored: the relay service process that hands asset state between the reference system and apps.

entries.name: ManagedBackgroundAssetsXPC
entries.note: Background downloads for apps are in the SDK and the UI model. Not mirrored: the XPC interface of the reference asset service, because BifrOSt uses its own IPC.

entries.name: ManagedClient
entries.note: Client side of enterprise device management. Its only extension applies configuration profiles pushed by a management server, which BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: ManagedConfiguration
entries.note: Store and installer for configuration profiles sent by enterprise device management. BifrOSt has no profile format and no enrolment.

entries.name: ManagedConfigurationFiles
entries.note: Files of installed configuration profiles for enterprise device management. They exist only when a management server installs profiles, and BifrOSt has none.

entries.name: ManagedOrganizationContacts
entries.note: Organisation directory contacts pushed by enterprise device management. BifrOSt has no managed directory to pull contacts from.

entries.name: ManagedSettingsObjC
entries.note: Objective-C binding for managed setting keys set by enterprise device management. BifrOSt sets no managed keys.

entries.name: ManagedSettingsSupport
entries.note: Support code for managed setting keys set by enterprise device management. BifrOSt sets no managed keys.

entries.name: Mangrove
entries.note: 2D drawing runs in-process in the bifrost-render cg module. Not mirrored: the separate graphics services agent process that the reference runs for drawing requests.
entries.ready_note: 2D drawing runs in-process in bifrost_render::cg, with its unit tests. The separate graphics agent process is not mirrored.

entries.note: private framework, owner MapKit; from SDK matrix mapkit.json

entries.name: MapsIntelligence
entries.note: private framework, owner MapKit; from SDK matrix mapkit.json

entries.note: private framework, owner MapKit; from SDK matrix mapkit.json

entries.note: private framework, owner MapKit; from SDK matrix mapkit.json

entries.note: private framework, owner MapKit; from SDK matrix mapkit.json

entries.name: MapsUI
entries.note: private framework, owner MapKit; from SDK matrix mapkit.json

entries.name: Marco
entries.note: Looked for the purpose in the reference index and the extracted tree: only the framework skeleton and localisation folders are listed, and no name points at a BifrOSt counterpart. Left as os until it can be read.

entries.name: MarketplaceIntents
entries.note: Intents that open the reference vendor's software store. BifrOSt has no store, so there is no store to hand an intent to.

entries.name: MarkupUI
entries.note: Pen and marker annotation work in markup.rs for screenshots and in the Preview canvas for documents. Not mirrored: a system Markup extension point that other apps and image editors call.
entries.ready_note: Pen and marker annotation for screenshots is in shell::markup, with unit tests. A system Markup extension point is not built.

entries.name: Marrs
entries.note: Looked for the purpose in the reference index and the extracted tree: only the framework skeleton is listed, with no binary or resources, and no name points at a BifrOSt counterpart. Left as os until it can be read.

entries.name: MaterialKit
entries.note: Vibrancy and layer materials are modelled in the render crate and in the layers crate. Not covered: the reference's platter and vibrant style sets, which are resources and not code.
entries.ready_note: Vibrancy and layer materials in bifrost-render vibrancy and bifrost-layers layer, tested. The reference platter and vibrant style sets are not covered.

entries.name: MathTypesetting
entries.note: Math layout engine in springboard/render/src/math: LaTeX subset and linear input parsed to a tree (frac, sqrt, scripts, big operators with limits, left/right delimiters, matrices, text), laid out with TeX rules (styles, spacing table, fraction, radical, script shifts, stretched delimiters) using OpenType MATH constants when the font has them. Painter in math/paint.rs. Formulas use the installed Noto Sans Math (OFL, noto-fonts-extra) and its MATH table; TeX defaults when the file is missing. Notes renders $...$ inline and $$...$$ display math in markdown mode (shell/textarea.rs). Not done: the Calculator display, and a device check of Notes.
entries.ready_note: The math layout engine (parser, TeX-rule layout, painter) is in springboard/render/src/math and uses the installed Noto Sans Math font.

entries.name: MatrixKit
entries.note: Only the bundle identifier is in the reference index. No daemon, plist or linked app names it, so its purpose stays unknown after reading the index and the reference plists.

entries.name: MatterPlugin
entries.note: private framework, owner Matter; from SDK matrix matter.json

entries.name: MediaAgnosticUSB
entries.note: Only the bundle identifier is in the reference index. Its name suggests USB media-class devices, but no binary is indexed and no plist names it, so the purpose stays unconfirmed; the Linux side is the kernel UVC and USB audio drivers.

entries.name: MediaAnalysis
entries.note: Photo and video content analysis (faces, scenes, pets, highlights) is the job of the reference analysis daemon; BifrOSt Photos groups by date, bursts and duplicates only and has no on-device analysis. Build an analysis index over the local library, fed by an on-device model.

entries.name: MediaAnalysisAccess
entries.note: Access helper for the on-device media analysis daemon. Needed by the analysis feature, which BifrOSt lacks; build it together with the analysis index.

entries.name: MediaAnalysisBlastDoorSupport
entries.note: Sandboxed parser that the analysis pipeline uses on untrusted media before analysis. BifrOSt parses media in the process that plays it (springboard/src/media/demux). Build a sandboxed media parser (bubblewrap is in the runtime package list) when the analysis index exists.

entries.name: MediaAnalysisCore
entries.note: Core types and models of the media analysis engine. Part of the analysis feature BifrOSt lacks; build with the analysis index.

entries.name: MediaAnalysisPhotosServices
entries.note: Photos-side store and services for analysis results. BifrOSt Photos keeps no analysis results; build with the analysis index.

entries.name: MediaAnalysisServices
entries.note: Client services for the media analysis engine. Part of the analysis feature BifrOSt lacks; build with the analysis index.

entries.name: MediaContinuityKit
entries.note: Continuity of media playback between the reference vendor's own devices . It has no meaning on one Arch Linux machine.

entries.name: MediaControl
entries.note: A message service that carries media commands between the reference vendor's paired devices; BifrOSt has no such transport, and local transport commands go through the now_playing service.

entries.name: MediaControlReceiver
entries.note: A message service that carries media commands between the reference vendor's paired devices; BifrOSt has no such transport, and local transport commands go through the now_playing service.

entries.name: MediaControlSender
entries.note: A message service that carries media commands between the reference vendor's paired devices; BifrOSt has no such transport, and local transport commands go through the now_playing service.

entries.name: MediaControlUI
entries.note: On-screen remote for the reference vendor's paired media devices . Those devices are not part of BifrOSt; local transport controls are in the Control Center tile and the menu bar extra.

entries.name: MediaConversionService
entries.note: The ffmpeg and imagemagick packages convert video and images on demand, which covers the conversion jobs. There is no Photos conversion service, and sharing does not transcode media.
entries.ready_note: ffmpeg and imagemagick are installed from runtime-packages.txt and perform the conversion jobs on demand.

entries.name: MediaCoreUI
entries.note: The Now Playing card and the player capsule draw the playback controls. Not covered: the animated level bars and the shared media control views of the reference framework.
entries.ready_note: The Now Playing card and player capsule draw the playback controls, with unit tests for the card model.

entries.name: MediaExperience
entries.note: Output routing between speaker and headphones, with the headphone safety cap, is in route.rs. Gap: no smart routing for browser media and no interruption priority between apps.
entries.ready_note: Output routing between speaker and headphones with the headphone cap (media::route), tested. Smart routing for browser media is not covered.

entries.name: MediaFoundation
entries.bifrost: springboard/src/media/mod.rs (MP4 demux, AAC decode, VideoDecoder trait)
entries.note: The media core demuxes MP4 and decodes AAC and video in-process. Gap: no general codec registry and no plug-in format support beyond these.
entries.ready_note: The media core demuxes MP4 and decodes AAC and video in process (springboard media module), tested. A general codec registry is not covered.

entries.name: MediaIntentsAISBridge
entries.note: private framework, owner MediaIntents; from SDK matrix media-intents.json

entries.name: MediaIntentsSnippetModels
entries.note: private framework, owner MediaIntents; from SDK matrix media-intents.json

entries.name: MediaKit
entries.note: The framework holds boot and loader resources for installer or recovery media (EFI loaders, database and inventory plists). The BifrOSt boot path is springboard/bootweave/efi and the native installer; the mapping was not verified, so the status stays os.

entries.name: MediaML
entries.note: On-device machine-learning models for media, the same feature as media analysis. Build it with the analysis index.

entries.name: MediaMLServices
entries.note: Service process that hosts the media machine-learning models . Build with the analysis index.

entries.name: MediaMiningKit
entries.note: Its caches (business-category, location and public-event caches) are filled by the reference vendor's location and public-event services, and it holds country and season tables for the vendor's Photos memories. BifrOSt has no such services.

entries.name: MediaPlaybackCore
entries.note: The playback engine plays audio and video from the media player. Gap: there is no separate playback-core API that other apps can call.
entries.ready_note: The playback engine (media::player, media::audioplayer), tested. A separate playback-core API for other apps is not covered.

entries.name: MediaRemote
entries.note: Apps publish a Now Playing session and receive transport commands through the now_playing service, and Control Center and the menu bar show it. Gap: there is no system-wide media daemon for remote devices, and artwork is not carried.
entries.ready_note: Apps publish a Now Playing session and receive transport commands through the now_playing service, tested. Device-to-device remote control is not covered.

entries.name: MediaRemoteDaemonServices
entries.note: The service side of the Now Playing session (publish, clear and command routing) is the now_playing service. The reference daemon's device-to-device remote is not built.
entries.ready_note: The service side of the Now Playing session (publish, clear, command routing) in shell::services::now_playing, tested.

entries.name: MediaServices
entries.note: Only the bundle identifier is in the reference index . No plist or daemon names it, so its purpose stays unconfirmed after reading the index.

entries.name: MediaStream
entries.note: Shared media streams (the shared streams service with its sharing push channels). The sharing runs through the reference vendor's push and account services, which BifrOSt does not have.

entries.name: MemoryAccounting
entries.note: Only the bundle identifier is in the reference index . Its job is probably per-process memory accounting, but no daemon or plist confirms it, so the status stays os. Activity Monitor reads /proc/meminfo in springboard/apps/activity-desktop/src/sample.rs.

entries.name: MemoryDiagnostics
entries.note: Only the bundle identifier is in the reference index . The reference memory-maintenance daemon sends memory and jetsam reports, so this may be part of that telemetry, but the index does not confirm it, so the status stays os.

entries.name: MenuBarClient
entries.note: Apps publish menu bar extras (status items) that the shell draws in the menu bar. Gap: the reference menu bar agent's own system extras are not handled through this client, and the framework's bundled extras are not reproduced.
entries.ready_note: Apps publish menu bar extras that the shell draws (shell::extras), tested.

entries.name: MenuBarClientCore
entries.note: The core side of menu bar extras is covered by the same status-item registry in extras.rs. Gap: the reference framework's extra-layout rules are not reproduced.
entries.ready_note: The status-item registry in shell::extras, tested. The reference extra-layout rules are not reproduced.

entries.name: MessageProtection
entries.note: Trust store for the reference vendor's message identities . It only has meaning for the vendor's messaging service, which BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: MessageSecurity
entries.note: Timestamp service for the reference vendor's message signing . It belongs to the vendor's messaging service, which BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: MessageUIMacHelper
entries.note: Compose-sheet helper for the reference vendor's message and mail compose sheets. BifrOSt Messages is a Matrix client that composes in its own window (springboard/apps/messages-desktop).

entries.name: MessagesBlastDoorSupport
entries.note: Sandboxed parser for the reference vendor's payloads and their language codecs. BifrOSt Messages is a Matrix client and does not parse that format.

entries.name: MessagesCloudSync
entries.note: Sync of message history through the reference vendor's cloud service. BifrOSt has no such cloud service, and its Messages app syncs through Matrix.

entries.name: MessagesEscrow
entries.note: Escrow of message keys in the reference vendor's escrow service, tied to cloud account recovery. BifrOSt has no such service.

entries.name: MessagesHelperKit
entries.note: Could not classify: the reference index lists only directories for this bundle and no binary is extracted, so its helper role is unknown.

entries.name: MessagesKit
entries.note: The Messages app model (rooms, selection, composer and sign-in state) covers the chat job of this framework, as a homeserver client. Gap: the reference conversation, attachment and sync APIs are not mirrored.
entries.ready_note: The Messages app model (rooms, selection, composer, sign-in state) is tested. It is a homeserver client, not the reference transport.

entries.name: MessagesSecurityPolicy
entries.note: Security policy of Apple's own message service. BifrOSt's Messages app talks to a homeserver, not to that service, so the policy has no meaning here.

entries.name: MessagesSettingsUI
entries.note: Settings for the reference's iCloud Messages sync (the MessagesSettings and iCloudMessagesSettings string tables seen in the reference index). That sync is an Apple account service BifrOSt does not run, so n/a.

entries.name: MetadataUtilities
entries.note: Could not classify: the name does not say which metadata it handles, and the reference index holds no binary to inspect.

entries.name: MetalMetrics
entries.note: The counter model in counter_sample covers the sampling side of GPU profiling that this framework feeds (data/metal.json). Gap: no hardware GPU counters are read on the desktop path.
entries.ready_note: The counter model (bifrost-ui counter_sample) that GPU profiling feeds, tested. Hardware GPU counters are not covered.
